data.name: Mubina
data.gender_notes: Mubina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘mubin’ meaning clear, evident, and pure. The name Mubina symbolizes a person who is pure, chaste, and has a clear understanding of Islam. The name Mubina carries the meaning “Pure, Chaste” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mubina usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, chaste and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying purity and righteousness in the eyes of Allah.
data.etymology: Mubina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Chaste.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubina total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Mubina
in_english.meaning: Clear, evident, one who makes things clear
in_english.long_meaning: Mubina is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'b-y-n' which means 'to clarify' or 'to make clear'. The name signifies clarity, transparency, and truthfulness. In Islamic tradition, it is considered a virtuous name as it reflects the qualities of honesty and openness. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the importance of clear communication and sincerity.
